pages.title: 5 multiblocs L8 (le plus de machines)
pages.text: $(l)5 multiblocs$() sur cette ligne (la plus complexe) :$(br)$(li)$(#248)MB-SOXHLET$() (3x5x3) -- extraction Manifoldine$(li)$(#248)MB-CYCLO$() (3x5x3 nuit ⭐⭐⭐) -- cyclisation stellaire$(li)$(#248)MB-EVAPORATOR$() (3x3x3) -- cristallisation$(li)$(#248)MB-ALAMBIC$() (3x3x3) -- mana distillation$(li)$(#248)MB-MANA-ENCHANTER$() (3x2x3) -- charge manaique

pages.title: MB-CYCLO (3x5x3) ⭐⭐⭐
pages.text: $(l)Cyclisateur Stellaire$() -- 3x5x3, 45 blocks including the controller.$(br)$(li)Y=+3 : 5 item bus, 4 decorative casing$(li)Y=+2 : 5 casing or hatch, 4 decorative casing$(li)Y=+1 : 5 casing or hatch, 4 decorative casing$(li)Y=+0 : 4 decorative casing, 4 casing or hatch$(li)Y=-1 : 4 decorative casing, 4 fluid hatch, 1 energy hatch$(br2)$(o)The 3D view of the structure follows later in this entry.

pages.title: MB-ALAMBIC + MB-MANA-ENCHANTER
pages.text: $(l)Alambic Manaique$() -- 3x3x3, 27 blocks including the controller.$(br)$(li)Y=+1 : 5 item bus, 4 decorative casing$(li)Y=+0 : 4 decorative casing, 4 casing or hatch$(li)Y=-1 : 4 decorative casing, 4 fluid hatch, 1 energy hatch$(br2)$(o)The 3D view of the structure follows later in this entry.
